selection.summary: Pretty-print support for DOM is implemented via the formatter-parametrized string_builder in include/simdjson/dom/serialization.h. Evidence delivered covers: (1) the string_builder<mini_formatter> template and mini_formatter interface (comma/start_array/end_array/start_object/end_object/key/string/number atoms, clear/str), which is designed to support both minification and prettification; (2) the public dom::operator<< overloads for element/array/object and to_string/minify free functions that currently use the default mini_formatter; and (3) the file tail including minify documentation. Adding pretty printing requires a new formatter class (e.g. with fixed four-space indentation) passed as the string_builder formatter parameter and a public entry point (e.g. a pretty-print stream operator or prettify function) reusing these hooks; the implementation source for mini_formatter methods was not located in delivered evidence, so the patch is not verified.
